name: SMAD family member 4

function.text: SMAD4 encodes a shared signaling mediator that forms complexes with receptor-activated SMAD proteins to regulate transcription downstream of TGF-β superfamily receptors.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include Myhre syndrome (autosomal dominant); juvenile polyposis/hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia syndrome (autosomal dominant). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Gallbladder carcinoma; Ampullary adenocarcinoma; Colorectal adenocarcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
